cards.claim: The Liturgy of St. John Chrysostom, Op. 31, is a musical work by Sergei Rachmaninoff.
cards.quote: John Chrysostom (Rachmaninoff) Liturgy of St John Chrysostom, Op. 31 (), is a musical work by Sergei Rachmaninoff, one of his two major unaccompanied choral works (the other being his All-Night Vigil). The Divine Liturgy of St. John Chrysostom is the primary worship service of the Eastern Orthodox Church. Rachmaninoff composed the work in July, 1910 at his summer estate Ivanovka, following his American tour of 1909.
